$comment: Declared coverage gaps. validate-lib.mjs fails on any manifest component,
variant combination, or type-scale token that has neither a library entry
nor an entry here — so silence is a failure and every deferral is a written
decision with an owner and a date.
bucket: 'overlay'   — needs force-open harness work (see excalidraw-librarian.md)
'complex'   — data-driven; a labelled placeholder is the honest glyph
'deferred'  — could be built today, not needed by any journey yet
Starter content below reflects the Phase 2 review. Delete or extend as the
library grows; anything removed from here must gain a real library entry.

Command.reason: Command palette — force-open harness supported, but no journey needs a palette yet.

Tooltip.reason: Transient hover affordance; too small to be a useful wireframe glyph.

Sonner.reason: Toaster is ephemeral and positioned by the runtime, not placed by a designer.

Calendar.reason: Date grid is data-driven; use a Select or Input glyph for date entry until a journey needs a full picker.

Carousel.reason: Motion component; a static glyph misrepresents it.

Chart.reason: Recharts wrapper — glyph would be a placeholder box. Revisit when a dashboard journey appears.

AspectRatio.reason: Layout utility with no visual identity of its own.

ScrollArea.reason: Scroll container; the scrollbar is the only visual and it is platform-styled.

typography.$note: Bold body variants and the Number/Amount styles from the standard are not yet in scale{} — add them here (or to typography.json) when a journey needs them.
